verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge is an agent knowledge and memory layer, so integrating with real-time voice pipelines is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs, voice pipelines, or latency fit for live conversation. The only documented connectors are Slack and Monday, which are data sources rather than voice integrations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can wire memory into real-time voice pipelines (e.g. LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs) with documented integrations fast enough for live conversation
